statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let S := fun d : ℕ => ∏ l ∈ d.primeFactors.filter (fun l => 2 < l), (((l:ℝ)-1)/((l:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (∑ p ∈ P X, ∑ q ∈ (P X).filter (fun q => p < q), S (q-p)) ≤ C*((P X).card:ℝ)^2

plain_statement.zh: 控制小素数对的位移奇异因子均值
plain_statement.en: Bound the mean singular weight over small prime pairs

brief.zh: 将乘积按平方自由约数展开。小约数估计同余素数对，尾部需控制重模数；对单个位移的最大值会损失常数。
brief.en: Expand over squarefree divisors, count congruent prime pairs for small divisors and control the large-divisor tail.
